description: This file contains type definitions, enums, data models, and configuration classes for integrating DynamoAI Guardrails API, including request/response structures, policy info, and configuration settings.

classes.name: DynamoRequestMetadata
classes.description: Metadata for DynamoAI requests, including optional end user ID

classes.name: DynamoTextType
classes.description: Enum for text types in DynamoAI (model input or response)

classes.name: PolicyMethod
classes.description: Enum for different policy methods such as PII, toxicity, etc.

classes.name: PolicyApplicableTo
classes.description: Enum indicating whether policy applies to input, output, or all

classes.name: DynamoAIRequest
classes.description: Request structure for DynamoAI moderation API

classes.name: PolicyInfo
classes.description: Details of a policy returned from DynamoAI

classes.name: PolicyOutputs
classes.description: Outputs from a policy, including action and message

classes.name: AppliedPolicyDto
classes.description: Details of an applied policy including its info and outputs

classes.name: DynamoAIResponse
classes.description: Response structure from DynamoAI moderation API

classes.name: DynamoAIProcessedResult
classes.description: Processed result from DynamoAI guardrail check, including violations

classes.name: DynamoAIGuardrailConfigModel
classes.description: Configuration model for DynamoAI Guardrails, including API keys, base URL, policy IDs, and model ID

methods.name: ui_friendly_name
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for the DynamoAI Guardrails configuration
